sections.heading: A travel tracker that fills itself in
body: With the Dawarich app on your phone, your movements are recorded as you go. To create a trip you only give it a name and dates; Dawarich pulls in every point from that range and draws the route.
Older journeys work the same way: import Google Timeline, Polarsteps or GPX files and turn any past date range into a trip.

sections.heading: Everything about a trip on one page
body: Each trip shows its dates, a map of the route, the countries you passed through with the distance covered in each, your notes and photos from a connected Immich or PhotoPrism library.

sections.heading: Find any trip again
body: Search matches trip names, descriptions, notes and the countries a trip visited. Sort by date, name or longest distance, and filter by year, month or country. Filters stay in the page address, so you can bookmark a list such as every trip to Portugal.

sections.heading: A journal, not just a map
body: Notes support formatting, so a trip can hold what happened each day, not only where you were. Changing a trip's dates updates the route on the map while you edit, and deleting a trip never deletes your location history.

faqs.q: Do I have to start a trip before I travel?
faqs.a: No. Trips are made from your existing location history, so you can create one afterwards from any date range.

faqs.q: Which apps can record my travels?
faqs.a: The Dawarich apps for iOS and Android, or OwnTracks, Overland, GPSLogger and other supported trackers.

faqs.q: Can I import trips from Polarsteps or Google Timeline?
faqs.a: Yes. Import the Polarsteps or Google Timeline export, then create trips for the dates you want.

faqs.q: Can I add photos to a trip?
faqs.a: Yes, if you connect Immich or PhotoPrism. Photos taken during the trip appear on its page automatically.
Yes. A trip can be shared through a private link, which you can revoke at any time.
